properties.description: Four tests on a throwaway git repo of six committed exports: the first commit holding the id is found with its content_hash and git location in at most 5 reads; an id present from the start resolves to the first commit; a never-committed id is refused by name; an id that is a prefix of another does not match it.
properties.findings: 4/4 pass. Also run against reflow2's real history: dec:a-reconcile-stamps-every-check-it-compared resolved to 3302c3f (#572's merge) with that export's exact hash, in 11 reads.
properties.name: An unpinned decision's fork point is found in git — first containing export, its hash, bisected — and a never-committed one says so
